findings.title: Dual Policy Configuration Formats Detected

evidence.observation: YAML format exists for self improvement policy configuration
JSON version of self improvement policy coexists with YAML version

proposed_action.description: Standardize on a single policy format (YAML or JSON) and remove the redundant configuration file.

findings.expected_benefit: Prevents inconsistent policy definitions and configuration drift.

findings.title: Model Router Tag Alignment for Embed Task

evidence.observation: Routing policy specifies 'nomic-embed-text' without tag suffix

proposed_action.description: Explicitly align the task embedding model identifier to nomic-embed-text:latest in the routing policy.

findings.expected_benefit: Ensures deterministic model routing resolution and prevents mismatch during model invocation.

findings.title: Uncommitted Artifact in Working Tree

evidence.observation: Repository state is dirty with uncommitted file 'platform_runtime'

proposed_action.description: Commit necessary platform runtime files or add platform_runtime to .gitignore if it represents an ephemeral execution state.

findings.expected_benefit: Restores clean repository state and ensures consistent deployment state.
